Blessed Ammo (2): Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Shred when shooting once (next time the effect would apply). Lightning Fog (2): Pick up to two enemy units within 9", which take 4 hits each. Protective Dome (3): Pick up to three friendly units within 12", which get Evasive once (next time the effect would apply). Psychic Terror (3): Pick one enemy unit within 6", which takes 9 hits with Bane.
